details:
Normally you can join an open group instance from the group page or through your friend if they're on green/blue status and in the instance.

However, now if you leave such instance after joining you won't see it anymore: it won't appear on the group page. You still have a chance to see it in a regular instance list on the world page but it won't show you the number of friends in the instance anymore even if they're on green/blue.

The issue is present on PC and Android smartphone but it seems to happen more often on PC.

Screenshots:

1. Visible group instance with visible friends on green/blue.

2. Same instance after joining and leaving it. Friends don't show up anymore.

3. All friends that are in this public instance now appear to be in the "Private Instance" despite being on green/blue.

4. This also happened with other VRC groups too the same day, though some of those groups also had troubles opening their pages (there was some error message once but I couln't read/screenshot it). 

This, however, also affects other types of instances. 

5. A person is sleeping on green in a Friend+ instance. You can see the world and easily join a person via friend list.

6. After entering and leaving the person's instance begin to appear as private again even though it was not and the person certainly did not change the type in a minute.
title: After leaving availavle visible instance it turns into a "private" one
